# proxmox_roles (Data Source)

Fetches the list of all Proxmox VE access roles from `/access/roles`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_roles" "all" {}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `roles` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `privs` (String) Comma-separated list of privileges.
- `role_id` (String) Proxmox role identifier.
